'''Camp Pokéhearst''' is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Kanto]] [[region]] that appeared in ''[[EP070|Go West Young Meowth]]''. It is located east of [[Hollywood]]. It was unnamed in the Japanese version.

There is a [[baseball]] pitch where the campers practice. The campsite has a projector and large sheet, allowing them to show outdoor movies to the campers.
[[File:That Darn Meowth.png|left|220px|thumb|The outdoor movie area, showing ''That Darn Meowth!'']]
{{MTR}}'s earliest memory is waking up alone in the rain in a basket here. He was all alone, and was so hungry that he tried to eat a basket of baseballs. He ended up just knocking it over, causing the baseball coach to string him up from a tree as punishment. From this position, that evening he was able to watch the movie ''{{DL|Movies in the Pokémon world|That Darn Meowth!}}'', which was being shown as a special treat for the campers, direct from Hollywood. He then grabbed onto the next truck heading towards Hollywood.
